finding: With --base, the two refusals of GitRefSource send the reader to the wrong file. The key integration_branch comes from the tree of the --base revision (DEC-77), but the messages say only `the key integration_branch in docs/factory-settings.yaml names the branch <branch>, and git holds no branch <branch>` and `... whose tip is HEAD`. The other refusals of the key say `in docs/factory-settings.yaml at the revision <commit>`, as _settings_text builds it. A reader opens docs/factory-settings.yaml of the folder, which is the story head, and finds another value or no file. The scratch script /tmp/claude-1000/-home-matthiasdaues-Documents-datenschoenheit-agent-factory/89fd1670-49e4-4a59-97db-e1035150aa04/scratchpad/qa/probe-keys.sh commits integration_branch: v1.10.0 on feature/login only. The story head holds no docs/factory-settings.yaml, and the message still names that file without a revision. Fix: in crap-score, pass the `where` text of _settings_text through integration_branch and open_source to GitRefSource, and use it in both messages, so they name the revision as the other refusals do.
why_this_severity: Each case still exits 2 and names the key and the branch, as CG-14 requires, so the merge stops (no to fails_purpose). The reader must find out that the value comes from the base revision before fixing it. The code exists only on feature/crap-gate-trusted-source.
